notes.title: Psychopathy Assessment - Out Now on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5
notes.content:
Psychopathy Assessment developed by Tarba Paul Cornel is out now on PS4, and PS5. Psychopathy Assessment is a retro-80s V.H.S PS1 style analog horror game that blurs the line between reality and delusion. 



[previewyoutube="tC-EMDaC1c8;full"][/previewyoutube]GET IT ON PLAYSTATION - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015660

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 📢 Psychopathy Assessment is OUT NOW on Steam! 📢
notes.content:
Prepare to question your sanity and face the unknown with the Psychopathy Assessment! 

🎉 Immerse yourself in an analog horror experience from the 1980s, where reality and hallucination blend. Do you have what it takes to pass the high-stakes psychopathy test? 

Once your assessment is completed, you'll be plunged deeper into the twisted world of a psychopath.

https://i.imgur.com/gzocVvQ.png
https://i.imgur.com/XgVSzVZ.png
https://i.imgur.com/3thTi07.png
Features: 

 🔪 Unique Gameplay - Engage in a tense psychopathy test that determines if you're a psychopath, followed by PS1-style gameplay surprises.

 🎥 VHS Horror Aesthetic - Classic visuals, VHS filters, and a chilling atmosphere capture the haunting essence of analog horror.

 🧩 Psychological Immersion - Test your limits as you face unsettling questions, uncover your darkest thoughts, and witness the story unravel.


Your choices and actions will reveal your true nature… if you dare to discover it.

🔗 Grab Psychopathy Assessment on Steam now! Test your psyche, unravel the story, and find out if you’re really ready to face your inner demons.

Thank you for your support and enjoy the experience. We look forward to hearing your feedback and seeing how you survive Psychopathy Assessment!
